$comment: Parts that scripts/add.mjs copies into a site. 'to' is relative to the site folder. 'own' files are copied once and never overwritten: the site owns them from the start.

core.description: Router, nav, global search, theme toggle, markdown and source-link helpers.

theme.description: Default colour and font tokens. Replace per project.

diagram.description: SVG diagram renderer: grid layout, edge routing, pan and zoom, keyboard, highlights and step badges.

arch.description: Architecture view: diagram tabs, the map with a collapsible sidebar, fullscreen, the flow picker with / paths, flows as cards or a list, and a component index.

tldr.description: TL;DR view: a block map you open and zoom into the real architecture diagrams.

features.description: Features view: group rail with counts, search with group/ scopes and @component filters, cards or list, and an inspector with a small diagram, config, invariants, failure modes, flows and related features.

knob.description: Rotary view switcher for exactly three views. Set ATLAS_SITE.nav to "knob".
